query: I ALREADY HAVE OCI
expected_key_facts: If you are already an OCI Cardholder, you should not apply for a new OCI registration — use 'OCI Miscellaneous Services' instead.

OCI Miscellaneous Services covers things like issuance of a new passport, change of personal particulars (name, address, occupation, nationality), loss/damage of the OCI card, and correction of wrong particulars filed earlier.
The OCI Miscellaneous Services fee is $25 (plus $3 ICWF and $19 VFS service fee per application); a card-replacement fee of $100 applies for a lost/damaged card.
Updating passport details is free of cost if done within 3 months of receiving the new passport.

query: OCI Miscellaneous Services
expected_key_facts: OCI Miscellaneous Services can only be availed by existing, registered OCI Cardholders, for things such as: issuance of a new passport, change of personal particulars (nationality, name, address, occupation), loss/damage of the OCI card, or correcting wrong particulars filed at the time of the original application.

After submitting the online application (with documents, photo, signature and fee), applicants must bring only the ORIGINALS of the supporting documents to the Indian Mission/Post/FRRO for verification — hard copies/printouts of the application or photocopies of uploaded documents are not required.
Fees: OCI Misc. Services $25, ICWF $3, VFS service fee $19 per application; re-issuance due to a lost/damaged card is $100.
Passport-detail updates are free (gratis) if uploaded within 3 months of receiving the new passport; a $25 fee applies if updated after that window.

query: My minor child just renewed her passport. I saw that the OCI does not have to be renewed again. I wanted to know where the picture had to be uploaded
expected_key_facts: An OCI cardholder is required to upload online a copy of the new passport and a recent photo (not more than 30 days old) each time a new passport is issued — this is not the same as physically reissuing the card.
Uploading is done at https://ociservices.gov.in/welcome under the 'OCI Miscellaneous Services' option, and does not involve submitting anything through VFS or the Consulate; it is free of cost.
This upload should be done within three months of receiving the new passport.
Mandatory physical re-issue of the OCI card itself is only required when the new passport is issued after the applicant completes 20 years of age (fee $25 plus $3 ICWF and VFS service charge).

query: How to apply for OCI
expected_key_facts: Eligibility must be checked first: a person who was an Indian citizen at any time, or is the child/grandchild/great-grandchild of such a person, or is the spouse of an Indian citizen/OCI holder (with 2+ years of subsisting marriage) may register; those with Pakistani/Bangladeshi lineage or foreign military/police personnel are not eligible.
Former Indian citizens must first obtain the Certificate of Renunciation of Indian citizenship before applying for OCI.

Process: complete the application online on the Government of India's OCI portal (uploading photo, signature, and required documents in the prescribed formats/sizes), then send the printed physical application with the fee and enclosures to the VFS India Consular Application Centre for the applicant's jurisdiction.
New OCI Card fees: $275 registration fee, $3 ICWF, and $19 VFS service fee per application (plus a 3.75% surcharge for card payments).

If the application remains incomplete for 20 calendar days, VFS returns it unprocessed with a partial refund; if requested additional documents are not submitted within 7 calendar days, processing may stop with no refund.
